description: Open the 'Sample House' project in NCH DreamPlan Home Design Software. Locate the living room (the large central room on the ground floor) and change all its interior wall surfaces to a Deep Red or Burgundy color (approximate Hex: #800020). After changing the wall colors, switch to the 3D view to verify the change. Finally, save the project as 'RedLivingRoom.ndp' in 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\DreamPlan\' and take a screenshot of the 3D view showing the red walls, saving it as 'red_walls_preview.png' in the same folder.
